visual_review.method: Compared every entity, printed package/stereotype and relationship in the complete source and four readable source crops against final Mermaid render. Checked role generalizations, self-association, parallel issuance/debt quantity associations and benchmark/interest links. The overlapping Derivative–Asset inheritance/UnderlyingAsset route was reconciled against FullBusinessModel!A1545:F1546, which separately establishes both. No numeric multiplicity is printed; none added.
